I added a 0.25s sleep after each request in `tests/test_payments.py`, set by a `CALL_INTERVAL_S` constant. The loop makes 4 calls, so they now go out at roughly 4 per second, under the sandbox's 5 per second limit. I haven't run the test, since it hits the live sandbox. Whether the CI flakiness is gone will only show up on CI runs.

If other tests also call the sandbox, they'll need the same spacing.

I also saved a note about the sandbox rate limit to EngramDB.
